SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS k, withdraw_frozen AS amount FROM ledger_account WHERE kind = 'USER' AND withdraw_frozen <> 0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.user_id, a.available, a.bet_locked, a.withdraw_frozen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.bucket = 'AVAILABLE' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS sum_available, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.bucket = 'BET_LOCKED' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS sum_bet_locked, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.bucket = 'WITHDRAW_FROZEN' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS sum_withdraw_frozen, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.bucket NOT IN ('AVAILABLE', 'BET_LOCKED', 'WITHDRAW_FROZEN') THEN 1 END) AS unknown_buckets FROM ledger_account a LEFT JOIN ledger_entry l ON l.account_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.kind, a.user_id, a.available, a.bet_locked, a.withdraw_frozen ) t WHERE t.sum_available <> t.available OR t.sum_bet_locked <> t.bet_locked OR t.sum_withdraw_frozen <> t.withdraw_frozen OR t.unknown_buckets > 0 ORDER BY t.id
SELECT entry_type, bucket, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM ledger_entry WHERE ref_market_id = #{marketId} GROUP BY entry_type, bucket

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS net, MIN(CASE WHEN l.entry_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'TEST_CREDIT', 'MANUAL_CREDIT') THEN l.created_at END) AS first_at FROM ledger_entry l JOIN ledger_account a ON a.id = l.account_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND l.bucket = 'AVAILABLE' AND (l.entry_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'DEPOSIT_REVERSAL', 'TEST_CREDIT') OR (l.entry_type = 'MANUAL_CREDIT' AND l.biz_type = 'ADJUST_DEPOSIT')) AND l.created_at >= #{since}
mapper.sql: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_type = 'PAYOUT' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS payout, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_type = 'COMPENSATION' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS compensation, COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_type IN ('BET_SETTLE', 'BET_LOST') THEN l.amount END), 0) AS stake, COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_type = 'FEE' THEN l.amount END), 0) AS fee
